notes.text: The general minor in theatre invites students to explore the many facets of this exciting field. Students have the opportunity to take a variety of classes in acting, playwriting, literature, stage management, directing, costume design and production. The curriculum is flexible and encourages students explore theatre through a broad combination of introductory and upper-division course work. All minor students are also eligible to participate in performance and production projects.
